title: Career Counseling and Placement Center Arranges an Orientation Session for Student Ambassadors
text:
The Career Counseling and Placement
Center (CCPC) of Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan organized an orientation
session for the student ambassadors in IBL Hall, AWKUM. Student ambassadors
from across all disciplines attended the orientation session and learned their
roles and responsibilities, along with the benefits they will receive.

Dr. Muhammad Bilal, Director, CCPC,
welcomed the student ambassadors and delivered a detailed orientation session.
The director briefed the students on how they will play an important role in
connecting their departments to the CCPC and industry. He added that during
industry tours, these ambassadors will create many opportunities for their
fellow students. Dr. Bilal explained that the linkages these ambassadors
establish with industry will be continued and passed on to junior fellow
students across departments. Through these linkages, ambassadors and other
students will better understand market saturation and the demands of the
modern-day market in terms of jobs, internships, and other opportunities. The
event concluded with an interactive Q&A session, followed by
refreshments.
